q.en: Fix: "Despite it was raining, we went out."
q.bn: ঠিক করো: "Despite it was raining, we went out."

options.en: Despite the rain, we went out.
options.bn: Despite the rain, we went out.

options.en: Despite it rained, we went out.
options.bn: Despite it rained, we went out.

options.en: Although the rain, we went out.
options.bn: Although the rain, we went out.

options.en: Despite of it was raining, we went out.
options.bn: Despite of it was raining, we went out.

why.en: "Despite" is followed by a noun or gerund, never a full clause with its own subject and verb.
why.bn: "Despite"-এর পরে noun বা gerund বসে, নিজস্ব subject-verb সহ full clause কখনো না।

q.en: Fix: "I went to his house, however he wasn't home."
q.bn: ঠিক করো: "I went to his house, however he wasn't home."

options.en: I went to his house, however, he wasn't home.

options.bn: I went to his house however he wasn't home.

options.en: I went to his house, however he was, home.
options.bn: I went to his house, however he was, home.

why.en: "However" is an adverb, not a conjunction — it can't join two full sentences with just a comma. Start a new sentence instead.
why.bn: "However" একটা adverb, conjunction না — এটা শুধু comma দিয়ে দুটো full sentence জোড়া দিতে পারে না। নতুন sentence শুরু করতে হবে।

options.en: because
options.bn: because

options.en: because of
options.bn: because of

options.en: although
options.bn: although

options.en: despite
options.bn: despite

why.en: "Because of" is followed by a noun phrase ("the weather"); "because" needs a full clause.
why.bn: "Because of"-এর পরে noun phrase বসে ("the weather"); "because"-এর পরে full clause লাগে।

options.en: although
options.bn: although

options.en: despite
options.bn: despite

options.en: so
options.bn: so

options.en: while
options.bn: while

why.en: "So" introduces a result. "Although", "despite", and "while" all introduce contrast.
why.bn: "So" result introduce করে। "Although", "despite", "while" সবই contrast introduce করে।

options.en: The exam was hard but I, passed it.
options.bn: The exam was hard but I, passed it.

why.en: The comma goes before "but", not right after it, when joining two clauses.
why.bn: দুটো clause জোড়া দেওয়ার সময় comma "but"-এর আগে বসে, ঠিক পরে না।
